subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron classification be modeled as freeform job tags, typed purpose/display metadata, or a plugin-owned classification seam?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested capability, but the durable API shape affects persisted cron state, Gateway protocol, CLI/UI filters, reminders, and plugin scheduling behavior, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Use typed metadata
options.body: Design a narrow typed purpose/display metadata contract that can cover reminders and system/user/project jobs without creating opaque plugin-owned blobs.

options.title: Add freeform tags
options.body: Add an optional normalized tags array to cron jobs and expose tag filtering consistently across storage, RPC/API, CLI, UI, tests, and docs.

options.title: Defer to plugin seam
options.body: Keep core cron schema lean and first extend plugin hooks/API only if classification can be owned outside core without losing filtering support.

recommendation.title: Use typed metadata
recommendation.body: Design a narrow typed purpose/display metadata contract that can cover reminders and system/user/project jobs without creating opaque plugin-owned blobs.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the clearest prior API/protocol design call on the closed cron metadata PR.
